description: The dataset pairs original and manipulated MQTT messages from physical and virtual water-level plants using a shared identifier. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Documented perturbation ranges are experimental settings, not observed real-world attack prevalence. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
